_note: Appendix 'Currencies' (user 2026-10-24). App-authored lines, each code-grounded in _su_extract (src = doc / data): LOOT.md § Currencies (S53 + S54 open items) and § Resources (S54: every source and sink of the five resources, data/model/currencies_extract.json 'resources'). Names come from the game's items.csv (name_key); desc_key = the game's own item description; frame = the icons-sheet frame from inv_ItemIconIndex (item_icons.json / DATABASES.md 'Item icons'). shop = {tab, group?}: build-data adds the shop and its price range from D.shops. Left out on purpose: Energy (no code creates it; its only shop, the Arcane Vault, is never offered), Sandbox amounts, and code whose reachability isn't confirmed (hard-coded English NPCs such as the breeding / summoning menus, Hot Hands / Think Fast / arm wrestling dwarves, Reid's 2,000-Granite arena, merchants, Torun's trade). Patch 3.0 teaser changes are left out (not code).
